def count_subarrays_with_min_k(arr, n, k):
    count = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] < k:
            continue
        left = i
        while left > 0 and arr[left - 1] >= k:
            left -= 1
        right = i
        while right < n - 1 and arr[right + 1] >= k:
            right += 1
        count += (i - left + 1) * (right - i + 1)
    return count
